title: USBLL: Code commenting and alignment
description:
Following changes in the file:
1. Brief comments on the Macros.
2. Explain usbll_address_t and usbll_data_t.
3. Grouping header fields belonging to the same type of packets.
4. Removed unnecessary condition check for usbll_data pointer in dissect_usbll_data function.
5. Correct code indentation at a few places.

Ping-Bug: #15908 
Signed-off-by: Ameya Deshpande <ameyanrd@outlook.com>
